source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only. The single live media turn (exec 13584318, captured as exec-13584318.json) was accepted+completed, so no refusal has ever been observed; this is reasoned from the node's own contract and the CRM wording contract it cites (app/services/media_extract/wording.py).
source.rationale: The rule the whole file is built around: on a refusal the CRM's notice IS the reply and n8n formats nothing. 'not_enabled' is in REFUSAL_KINDS, so it becomes primaryNotice, appendixTexts is empty, and reply_text is that notice text VERBATIM - a diff here means n8n started inventing customer copy. The decision, not the HTTP status, is what routes: the body arrived 200 OK. `reason` echoes the CRM decision so the trace can distinguish this from the generic '<decision>_no_notice' fallback. job_id is null because a refused request never created a job.
